content:
Dear all,

I would like to give an update on our Lean Refactor Competition (following up on our previous post at #general > Lean Refactor Competition,)

We have launched our Lean Refactor Competition at https://leanrefactor.github.io/

Our competition is also listed on Lean-related conferences and events.

Core Idea

We encourage refactoring methods that balance "proof length" vs. "compilation cost" vs. "Lean compatibility."

The importance of Lean code refactoring has been extensively discussed recently (see this Zulip chat, Tao's post, Leo's talk, ProofOptimizer, ImProver, Lean Refactor).

Awards/Prizes

We have secured $65K+ :money:  in support from multiple sponsors to reward winning solutions.

We sincerely thank our sponsors (to date):

Amazon AWS Automated Reasoning Group, Renaissance Philanthropy, Logical Intelligence, Pramaana Labs, Reasonable, Aretta, Harmonic

(More sponsors to be confirmed.)

Spotlight Talks

Winners will be invited (travel funded) to give oral presentations at our NeurIPS workshop on "AI for Verifiable Coding" https://vericodegen.github.io/

For Lean Repo Maintainers

This competition also gives your repo access to talented participants who can improve the most challenging proofs in your Lean project, supported by substantial financial incentives.
We require leaderboard submissions to release tech reports with reproducible methods for sustainable, long-term refactoring.

We encourage Lean repo maintainers to contribute long proofs that could benefit substantially from refactoring (see our contribution guidelines).

Timeline

  • Warm-up stage: now – Oct. 31, 2026
  • Final evaluation: Nov. 1 – 8, 2026
  • Decision: Nov. 22, 2026
